name: awesome-scalability
summary: Reading list of articles and case studies on scaling, reliability and performance of large-scale systems.
description: An organized reading list illustrating the patterns of scalable, reliable and performant large-scale systems, with sections for principles, scalability, availability, stability, performance, intelligence, architecture, interviews and organization. Concepts are explained in articles by prominent engineers; case studies come from battle-tested systems serving millions to billions of users.
